findings.reason: without that justification the plan should extend one shared bounded-wait helper, otherwise each future wait conversion adds another copy of the same loop.
findings.text: the wait-conversion node adds a per-file `_wait_for` that polls a predicate to a `WATCHER_LOAD_BOUND_SECONDS` deadline, a loop identical to the helper its sibling files and at least eight other test files already define, with no justification that the shared helper cannot carry it

findings.reason: naming the owner lets the plan consolidate the bounded-wait primitive once instead of paying a fresh per-file copy on every fixed-wait conversion.
findings.text: a generic bounded-wait-on-condition helper (`_wait_for(predicate, *, timeout=…)`) is redefined independently in at least nine test files, three of them with the identical `WATCHER_LOAD_BOUND_SECONDS` signature (`tests/test_crew_session_delivery.py:417`, `tests/test_removed_flag_migration.py:379`, `tests/test_follow_observes_other_sessions.py:128`), and the §3 fixed-wait nodes converted more waits without naming an owner; `tests/conftest.py` already exports cross-test helpers (`leaked_watch_producers`, `await_exit` at `:498`) that tests import via `from tests.conftest import …`

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the new checks live behind pytest autouse/session fixtures in one file (`tests/conftest.py`), which hides substantial session-level isolation (scheduler refusal, producer reaping, basetemp locking) behind the single fixture interface; no new module spreads shallow state across wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — bounded-wait-on-observed-condition is re-implemented across the test suite rather than owned by one helper; the owner to extend is `tests/conftest.py`, which already exports shared test helpers (`leaked_watch_producers`, `await_exit`).
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §3 builds on machinery it names and measured rather than proposing a greenfield harness: the leaked-producer reaper fixture it extends, the peer's `pytest-timeout`/`pytest-xdist` commit `d4c5a54a`, and the scheduler-shim the guard rides on; each proposed measure names the mechanism it touches.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — the fixed-wait conversion nodes add/keep per-file `_wait_for(predicate, …)` loops that are thin wrappers over one poll-until-condition mechanism, and neither node states why the existing shared helper cannot be extended.
